chapter: Joining Carter and Goodman in New York
title: Benny Carter at the Empire Ballroom and the move to Willie Bryant
summary: After Rich lost the Harlem club, Carter's band played the Empire Ballroom, then Wilson joined Willie Bryant, with Carter as musical director.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: some reason, he lost the Harlem club, and then Benny Carter took the band and got a job at the Empire Ballroom, which was downtown at 51st and Broadway -- upstairs. And we played opposite the Red Hague, and they had two bands, you know, the standard procedure at the dancehall. Continuous music.

And then that job, after awhile, when that job folded, Benny Carter gave up the band and I went with Willie Bryant, and Benny Carter went with Willie Bryant as musical director, so he put Willie Bryant's band in the shape that Benny Carter's band was, so Willie Bryant had done that, and he was doing a lot of network broadcasting with this band, an excellent band, and made quite a few Victor records, the Willie Bryant band.
